extension.summary: Library, MDBList, Jellyfin "Want to Watch" and seasonal widgets for Arctic Fuse, all resolved live against your local Kodi library
extension.description:
Every widget this addon provides is resolved live against your own Kodi library via JSON-RPC, which is what lets its items look exactly like the ones in Kodi's native views: watched ticks, resume progress, episode counts and collection folders all come through, none of which a plugin widget normally carries.
Four kinds of list, each independently addressable so a skin can point a shelf straight at it. [B]Library lists[/B] -- All, New, Random and Top Rated, for both movies and shows -- run as live library queries rather than smart playlists. [B]MDBList lists[/B] resolve a curated list against what you actually own, keeping its exact order: Trending Movies and Shows, the MCU in chronological order, Star Wars in chronological order, Best Picture winners. [B]"Want to Watch Movies" and "Want to Watch Shows"[/B] are built from your Jellyfin favourites -- heart something in any Jellyfin client and it turns up here, with no API key and no setup, because it reuses the login your Jellyfin addon already stores on that box. [B]Seasonal lists[/B] (Christmas, Halloween, Valentine's Day, May the 4th, Star Trek Day, Nick November, Friday the 13th) return empty outside their window so the skin's auto-hide shows and hides them for you.
Anything on your Want to Watch queue is starred wherever else it appears, using the favourite indicator your skin already has. Every built-in list can be switched off individually, and new lists can be added from the addon's own settings (label, type, URL, optional window) without redeploying. No external cron job and no file share required.
extension.news:
v2.6.3 (2026-09-01) - Much faster widget refreshes, and far less memory used while they run: a widget no longer reads every field of your whole library -- cast lists, plots and artwork for thousands of films -- just to show a handful of items.
v2.6.2 (2026-08-28) - Fixed: movie collections showed artwork but no text -- no year or plot was set.
v2.6.1 (2026-08-28) - Fixed: widget items showed no release date -- the "premiered" field was never set. - Fixed: shows showed no certificate; "mpaa" was missing from the show path. - Moved the seasonal items setting into the Seasonals category.
